product.name: Monoprice USB-C to 3.5mm Mic and 3.5mm Stereo Audio - Gaming Headset to PC Adapter
product.description: Monoprice™USB-C to 3.5mm Mic and 3.5mm Stereo Audio — Gaming Headset to PC AdapterGaming headsets with two separate 3.5mm plugs — one for audio out, one for microphone — are the standard for PC gaming, but USB-C-only laptops and modern desktops leave those headsets without a direct connection. The Monoprice USB-C to 3.5mm Mic and 3.5mm Stereo Audio Adapter solves this with a single USB-C plug that splits into a dedicated 3.5mm headphone output and a separate 3.5mm microphone input. Both aluminum shells are laser-engraved with function icons — a headphone symbol and a microphone symbol — so you never have to guess which plug is which.The 125mm nylon-braided cable adds durability without bulk, with a PVC core at 2.7mm OD and a nylon braid at 3.2mm OD. Nickel-plated contacts on all three connectors ensure a reliable, corrosion-resistant connection. Backed by the Monoprice lifetime limited warranty.Dual 3.5mm ports. One USB-C plug delivers a dedicated headphone output and a separate microphone input — no shared combo jack.Labeled aluminum shells. Laser-engraved headphone and microphone icons on each port mean you always connect to the right jack.Compact 125mm cable. Short enough to sit flush behind a workstation or fold flat in a laptop bag without excess slack.Nylon-braided construction. 3.2mm braid OD over a 2.7mm PVC core; resists tangling and daily handling wear.Nickel-plated connectors. All three ports — USB-C, headphone 3.5mm, and microphone 3.5mm — use nickel plating for corrosion resistance.USB-C audio output required. This adapter requires the host USB-C port to support audio output. Verify device specs; not compatible with charging-only USB-C ports. DUAL 3.5MM PORTSOne USB-C plug delivers a dedicated headphone output and a separate microphone input — separate jacks, separate signals. LABELED ALUMINUM SHELLSLaser-engraved headphone and mic icons mark each port permanently; CNC aluminum construction. 125 MM NYLON-BRAIDED CABLE3.2 mm braid OD over a 2.7 mm PVC core; compact enough for a laptop bag. NICKEL-PLATED CONTACTSUSB-C male and both 3.5mm female jacks; corrosion-resistant and long-lasting. WORKS WITH STANDARD GAMING HEADSETSBuilt for headsets with two separate 3.5mm plug — headphone out and microphone in.
